summary: Post-rollback (v1 single-org) verification. Backend: new regression file test_v1_rollback.py 15/16 pass (only brute-force lockout fails); full legacy suite 118/121 (1 lockout, 1 stale test expecting response body from /messages/simulate-inbound, 1 xdist-flaky ACL test that passes in isolation). Multi-org endpoints (/api/orgs, /api/events, /api/org-links, /api/super-admin/orgs) all 404; no org/event UI or testids remain. Frontend desktop: login->dashboard, live map, base layers Dark(Esri Dark Gray Canvas, no key)/Streets/Satellite/Terrain switch tiles correctly, overlay create/delete, shift log list + CSV download, register->pending->admin approve->login, dispatcher ACL modal save ('Group access saved'), situational token create + read-only view + bad-token ACCESS DENIED all work. Mobile 390px: tabbar + menu drawer work, BUT the Map tab shows no map (map height 0) because the PacketLog fills the space.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout ineffective behind ingress: identifier is f'{request.client.host}:{email}' and client.host is the ingress pod IP (seen 10.208.133.66 and .69), so failed attempts split across pods; 7+ consecutive bad logins never return 429. Use X-Forwarded-For first IP (or key on email only).

Returns {ok:true} instead of the stored message doc; legacy test tests/test_v12_features.py::TestMessages::test_simulate_inbound expects direction/text/talkgroup_id in the response. The message IS stored (direction='in'). Either return the doc or update the test.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px the Leaflet map renders with height 0 and width 891px. Root cause: Dashboard.jsx ~line 322 wraps MapView + PacketLog in 'grid h-full grid-rows-[1fr_auto]' and the non-embedded PacketLog has no max-height, so once there are a few dozen packets the auto row takes all height (and long log lines blow out the column width). Fix: grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] + wrap PacketLog in a fixed/max height container (e.g. max-h-40 overflow-hidden) or default bottomOpen=false on narrow.

Uncaught TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading _leaflet_pos)' (dev overlay) when navigating away (e.g. nav-admin) right after the dashboard loads while the initial fitBounds/setView zoom animation is running. Fix: map.stop() / cancel animation in cleanup, or fitBounds with {animate:false} for the initial auto-fit.

issues: Title 'DMR TRACKER / HOMEBREW MASTER · MULTI-BRAND GPS' wraps over ~6 lines; with header + operator bar + emergency banner about 210px of the 844px height is used before content. Consider hiding the subtitle/stats on narrow screens.

action_items: Fix mobile Map tab: map collapses to 0 height because PacketLog has no height cap in NarrowLayout (Dashboard.jsx grid-rows-[1fr_auto])
Stop/cancel Leaflet zoom animation on MapView unmount (_leaflet_pos error when navigating away during the initial fitBounds)
Make login lockout key use the X-Forwarded-For client IP (or email only) so 5 failed attempts actually return 429
Either return the stored message from /api/messages/simulate-inbound or update the stale legacy test
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1311 lines; should be split into routers (auth/admin, radios, overlays, situational, shift-log).
list_radios ACL query (server.py ~line 667) is a hard-to-read nested ternary; works, but should be simplified.

CORS uses allow_origins from env defaulting to '*' together with allow_credentials=True; auth is Bearer-token (no httpOnly cookies by design per auth.py docstring), so cookie checks from the playbook are N/A.
Legacy tests in /app/backend/tests hardcode a default BASE_URL fallback and ADMIN creds; they also leave lots of data behind (groups, emergencies, users) - no teardown.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (desktop flows all pass; mobile map tab broken)

test_credentials: admin@dmrtracker.app / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). bcrypt hash verified to start with $2b$.
seed_data_creation: Test runs created users/groups/radios/messages/emergencies/tokens; afterwards I wiped all collections back to the post-rollback state: only the admin user + 2 seeded channels remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v1 single-org app. Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_v1_rollback.py (pytest.ini enables xdist; use -n0 for isolation). Radio coords are 'last_lat'/'last_lon'. Situational tokens panel lives on /admin/users. Base layer names: Dark, Streets, Satellite, Terrain (+ Street labels overlay). To repro mobile bug: inject >20 packets, view at 390px, Map tab -> .leaflet-container height 0. Dev overlay iframe 'webpack-dev-server-client-overlay' may block clicks after the Leaflet error; remove it via JS to continue.
rca of the issue: Mobile map: NarrowLayout grid-rows-[1fr_auto] gives PacketLog (auto, uncapped) priority; the 1fr map row resolves to 0 when log content exceeds the viewport. Earlier iterations passed because the DB had few packets. Lockout: Starlette request.client.host is the ingress proxy pod IP, which varies by request across the ingress replicas.
